meta.name: content-writer
meta.description: Write SEO-optimized blog posts, landing pages, and content improvements following Google's E-E-A-T and Helpful Content guidelines. Handles new content creation from a keyword or topic, and improving existing pages. Use when asked to "write a blog post", "create a landing page", "improve this page", "write content about X", "content for keyword X", "draft an article", "blog post about", "landing page for", "service page", "product page copy", "rewrite this page", "make this page rank better", "content brief", "how-to guide", "listicle", or any content creation or improvement task for a website.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出符合谷歌SEO标准的高质量网页内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为网站创作或优化能提升搜索排名的内容。
copy.tagline_en: Write high-quality web content that meets Google SEO standards.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create or optimize website content for better search rankings.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会按网页搜索排名的写作流程来工作:根据关键词或主题写博客文章、落地页,或改进现有页面。先给提纲供确认,再交付完整正文、标题与描述、配图方案、结构化数据、内链计划。
howto.when: 当你要求“写一篇博客文章”“创建落地页”“改进/重写某个页面”,或给出现有页面的网址/文件让它修改时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一篇关于“本地搜索引擎优化”的博客文章
say.note: 它会先给提纲,确认后再写全文。

say.text: 我给你一个网址,请分析并重写这个页面
say.note: 它会先做差距分析,批准后才重写。

say.text: 为关键词“家庭装修报价”写一个落地页
say.note: 会生成页面文案、搜索优化信息和结构化数据。

howto.what_en: Claude writes SEO blog posts, landing pages, or improved versions of existing pages, and gets outline approval before delivering the full package (copy, metadata, image prompts, structured data, links, checklist).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to write a blog post, create a landing page, or improve/rewrite an existing page — including giving a URL or file path.

say_en.text: Write a blog post about local SEO optimization.
say_en.note: It will present an outline first, then write the full post.

say_en.text: Analyze and rewrite this page: https://example.com/services
say_en.note: It will give a gap analysis and rewrite after approval.

say_en.text: Create a landing page for the keyword 'home renovation quotes'.
say_en.note: It will provide page copy, SEO metadata, and structured data.
